$comment: GENERATED by python -m threetears.evals.vega.measure_font through text_metrics.write_font_metrics — do not hand-edit. Advances are a fraction of the font size, measured through vl-convert's own layout so they describe what Vega will do rather than what the font file says, in the first family of `font`. Linear in size, measured. Each advance is the widest across the measured weights, and across a character drawn between two H glyphs and in a run of itself. Kerning is not included: the per-character sum is an estimate carrying SAFETY_MARGIN, and the generator refuses to write a table whose corpus underestimates past it. font_files are the files that provided the measured face, relative to the directory measured from, by SHA-256; a renderer refuses the table once they differ. probe_digest is the SHA-256 of what was probed (characters, framing, size, corpus); a table probed with anything else is refused.
